params.title: Training Parameters
params.subtitle: Optional. Leave empty for defaults. Hover for details.

iterations.label: Iterations
iterations.desc: Total training iterations. Higher means better quality but longer training. Recommended 7000-30000.

resolution.label: Resolution Scale
resolution.desc: Image resolution scale. -1 auto, 1 original, 2 half. Higher is finer but slower.

sh_degree.label: SH Degree
sh_degree.desc: Spherical harmonics degree (0-3). Higher gives richer view-dependent color but larger model.

white_background.label: White Background
white_background.desc: Use white background instead of black. Suitable for product showcases.

eval.label: Evaluation Mode
eval.desc: Split dataset into train/test sets for quality evaluation.

densify_grad_threshold.label: Densify Grad Threshold
densify_grad_threshold.desc: Densification gradient threshold. Lower values produce more Gaussians - finer but larger.

densification_interval.label: Densification Interval
densification_interval.desc: Densification operation interval (iterations). Run every N iterations.

opacity_reset_interval.label: Opacity Reset Interval
opacity_reset_interval.desc: Opacity reset interval (iterations). Periodically reset to prevent overfitting.

densify_from_iter.label: Densify From Iter
densify_from_iter.desc: Iteration to start densification. No densification before this.

densify_until_iter.label: Densify Until Iter
densify_until_iter.desc: Iteration to stop densification. Gaussian count fixed after this.

lambda_dssim.label: SSIM Loss Weight
lambda_dssim.desc: SSIM loss weight (0-1). Higher values structural similarity, lower values pixel L1.

percent_dense.label: Percent Dense
percent_dense.desc: Densification density threshold percentage. Controls which regions need more Gaussians.

random_background.label: Random Background
random_background.desc: Use random background colors during training for robustness.

antialiasing.label: Antialiasing
antialiasing.desc: Enable antialiasing for better edge quality, but increases training time.
